## Trip Distribution

The model used the 2012 Household Travel Survey to calibrate trip lengths for internal and external person trips. Trips were calibrated based on generalized cost trip length frequencies and validated to time and distance trip length frequencies and average trip lengths. The validation results are shown in @fig-ave-trip-length and @fig-trip-length-freq. Trip lengths by time and distance met the validation targets and aligned closely with observed data.

No observed data was available for internal and external commercial vehicle calibration. CV trips were calibrated based on previous model estimation and validated relative to person work and other trip lengths.

```{python}
# ------------------------------------------------ #
# 1. Define Standardization Maps
# ------------------------------------------------ #

# Map modeled truck names to the standard names
mod_trip_map = {
    'II_LT': 'LT',
    'II_MD': 'MD',
    'II_HV': 'HV'
}

# Map uppercase observed names to your preferred standard names
obs_trip_map = {
    'HBSHP': 'HBShp',
    'HBOTH': 'HBOth',
    'HBSCH_PR': 'HBSch_Pr',
    'HBSCH_SC': 'HBSch_Sc'
}

# Map the standard trip purposes to the skim matrix names for joining
skim_join_map = {
    'IX': 'Ext',
    'XI': 'Ext',
    'IX_MD': 'Ext',
    'XI_MD': 'Ext',
    'IX_HV': 'Ext',
    'XI_HV': 'Ext',
    'HBSch_Pr': 'HBS',
    'HBSch_Sc': 'HBS',
    'II_LT_D2D': 'LT',
    'II_LT_HnS': 'LT',
    'II_LT_Lcl': 'LT',
    'II_LT_Reg': 'LT',
    'II_LT_LHl': 'LT',
    'II_LT_Unk': 'LT',
    'II_MD_D2D': 'MD',
    'II_MD_HnS': 'MD',
    'II_MD_Lcl': 'MD',
    'II_MD_Reg': 'MD',
    'II_MD_LHl': 'MD',
    'II_MD_Unk': 'MD',
    'II_MD_Adj': 'MD',
    'II_HV_D2D': 'HV',
    'II_HV_HnS': 'HV',
    'II_HV_Lcl': 'HV',
    'II_HV_Reg': 'HV',
    'II_HV_LHl': 'HV',
    'II_HV_Unk': 'HV',
    'II_HV_Adj': 'HV'
}

# ------------------------------------------------ #
# 2. Helper Function with Renaming Capability
# ------------------------------------------------ #
def extract_omx_to_df(omx_path, matrix_names, val_col_name, rename_dict=None, optional_missing=None):
    df_list = []
    taz_ids = np.arange(1, 3630)
    rename_lookup = {k.upper(): v for k, v in (rename_dict or {}).items()}
    optional_missing = {m.upper() for m in (optional_missing or [])}

    with omx.open_file(omx_path, 'r') as f:
        matrix_lookup = {mat.upper(): mat for mat in f.list_matrices()}

        for mat_name in matrix_names:
            mat_key = mat_name.upper()
            actual_mat_name = matrix_lookup.get(mat_key)

            if actual_mat_name is None:
                if mat_key not in optional_missing:
                    print(f"Warning: {mat_name} not found in OMX")
                continue

            mat = np.array(f[actual_mat_name]).astype(float)
            ii, jj = np.nonzero(mat)

            # Apply renaming if a dictionary is provided, otherwise keep the original name
            std_purpose = rename_lookup.get(mat_key, mat_name)

            df_mat = pd.DataFrame({
                "i": taz_ids[ii],
                "j": taz_ids[jj],
                val_col_name: mat[ii, jj],
                "Purpose": std_purpose
            })

            df_list.append(df_mat)

    if df_list:
        return pd.concat(df_list, ignore_index=True)
    else:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=["i", "j", val_col_name, "Purpose"])

# ------------------------------------------------ #
# 3. Execute Extraction & Merge (modeled side: one calibration run at a time;
#    observed side: shared, extracted once)
# ------------------------------------------------ #
obs_trips = extract_omx_to_df(
    config_paths["skm_obs"],
    purp_mats_obs + truck_mats_obs + ext_mats_obs,
    "Trips_Obs",
    rename_dict=obs_trip_map
)

def _load_mod_trips_dist_gc(calib_run, outputs_dir):
    mod_trips = extract_omx_to_df(
        outputs_dir / "PA_AllPurp_GRAVITY.omx",
        purp_mats + truck_mats + ext_mats,
        "Trips_Mod",
        rename_dict=mod_trip_map
    )
    mod_dist = extract_omx_to_df(outputs_dir / "skm_DY_Dist.omx", purp_mats_skim, "Dist")
    mod_gc = extract_omx_to_df(outputs_dir / "skm_DY_GC.omx", purp_mats_skim, "GC")

    df = pd.merge(mod_trips, obs_trips, on=['i', 'j', 'Purpose'], how='outer')
    df['Trips_Mod'] = df['Trips_Mod'].fillna(0)
    df['Trips_Obs'] = df['Trips_Obs'].fillna(0)

    # Create a temporary 'Skim_Purpose' column to link up with the skims (maps 'IX' to 'Ext', etc.)
    df['Skim_Purpose'] = df['Purpose'].apply(lambda x: skim_join_map.get(x, x))
    mod_dist = mod_dist.rename(columns={'Purpose': 'Skim_Purpose'})
    mod_gc = mod_gc.rename(columns={'Purpose': 'Skim_Purpose'})

    df = pd.merge(df, mod_dist, on=['i', 'j', 'Skim_Purpose'], how='left')
    df = pd.merge(df, mod_gc, on=['i', 'j', 'Skim_Purpose'], how='left')
    df = df.drop(columns=['Skim_Purpose'])
    df['Dist'] = df['Dist'].fillna(0)
    df['GC'] = df['GC'].fillna(0)
    return df

df_flat = vs.load_per_run(repo_root, _load_mod_trips_dist_gc)
```

```{python}
# 1. CALCULATE EXACT AVERAGES (grouped by calib_run too -- df_flat holds
#    every calibration run's modeled data; Observed is recomputed per run's
#    subset, which is redundant but not wrong, since Trips_Obs is identical
#    across runs)
avg_records = []
for var_col, var_name in [('Dist', 'Dist'), ('GC', 'GC')]:
    for source_col, source_name in [('Trips_Mod', 'Model'), ('Trips_Obs', 'Observed')]:

        # Calculate weighted average: sum(Trips * Value) / sum(Trips)
        grouped = df_flat.groupby(['Purpose', 'calib_run']).apply(
            lambda x: (x[source_col] * x[var_col]).sum() / x[source_col].sum() if x[source_col].sum() > 0 else np.nan
        ).reset_index(name='AVG_TRIP_LEN')

        grouped['DataSource'] = source_name
        grouped['Variable'] = var_name
        avg_records.append(grouped)

gcdtime_Stats = pd.concat(avg_records, ignore_index=True)

# 2. CALCULATE TRIP LENGTH FREQUENCIES (TLF)
df_flat['Dist_BIN'] = np.floor(df_flat['Dist']).astype(int)
df_flat['GC_BIN'] = np.floor(df_flat['GC']).astype(int)

tlf_records = []
for var_col, var_name in [('Dist_BIN', 'Dist'), ('GC_BIN', 'GC')]:
    for source_col, source_name in [('Trips_Mod', 'freqMod'), ('Trips_Obs', 'freqObs')]:

        # Group by purpose, run, and bin, sum the trips
        binned = df_flat.groupby(['Purpose', 'calib_run', var_col])[source_col].sum().reset_index()
        binned.rename(columns={var_col: 'BIN', source_col: 'TRIPS'}, inplace=True)

        # Calculate percentage (frequency) within each purpose x run
        total_trips = binned.groupby(['Purpose', 'calib_run'])['TRIPS'].transform('sum')
        binned = binned[total_trips > 0].copy()
        if binned.empty:
            continue

        total_trips = binned.groupby(['Purpose', 'calib_run'])['TRIPS'].transform('sum')
        binned['freq'] = binned['TRIPS'] / total_trips

        binned['TLFTYPE'] = var_name
        binned['freqSource'] = source_name
        binned.rename(columns={'Purpose': 'TRIPPURP'}, inplace=True)

        tlf_records.append(binned[['TRIPPURP', 'calib_run', 'BIN', 'freq', 'TLFTYPE', 'freqSource']])

dfObsModelMerge = pd.concat(tlf_records, ignore_index=True)
```

### Intrazonal Trip Percentage

```{python}
# ------------------------------------------------ #
# Calcualte Observed Intrazonal Trip Percentages   #
# ------------------------------------------------ #
# read in hts trip table, filter to WF model area, calculate purpose
hts_trips = pd.read_csv(config_paths["hts_trips_path"], low_memory=False)
hts_trips = hts_trips[(hts_trips['pSUBAREAID']==1) & (hts_trips['aSUBAREAID']==1)]
hts_trips['PURP'] = np.where(
    hts_trips['PURP7_t'] == 'HBSch',
    np.where(
        hts_trips['HBSch_lev'] == 'primary',
        'HBSch_Pr',
        np.where(
            hts_trips['HBSch_lev'] == 'secondary',
            'HBSch_Sc',
            pd.NA
        )
    ),
    hts_trips['PURP7_t']
)

# filter out na and select columns
hts_trips = hts_trips[~hts_trips['PURP'].isna()]
hts_trips = hts_trips[hts_trips['trip_weight'] > 0]
hts_trips = hts_trips[['linked_trip_id','PURP','pCO_TAZID_USTMv4','aCO_TAZID_USTMv4','trip_weight']]

# flag intrazonal trips
hts_trips['is_intra'] = (hts_trips['pCO_TAZID_USTMv4'] == hts_trips['aCO_TAZID_USTMv4'])

# weighted totals by purpose
obs_intra = (
    hts_trips
        .assign(
            intra_wt = lambda x: np.where(x['is_intra'], x['trip_weight'], 0)
        )
        .groupby('PURP', as_index=False)
        .agg(
            total_trips_wt=('trip_weight', 'sum'),
            intra_trips_wt=('intra_wt', 'sum')
        )
)

# percent intrazonal
obs_intra['pct_intrazonal'] = (100 * obs_intra['intra_trips_wt'] / obs_intra['total_trips_wt'])
obs_intra = obs_intra[['PURP','pct_intrazonal']]
```


```{python}
# ------------------------------------------------ #
# Calcualte Modeled Intrazonal Trip Percentages    #
# (one calibration run at a time)                  #
# ------------------------------------------------ #
def _load_mod_intra(calib_run, outputs_dir):
    results = []
    with omx.open_file(outputs_dir / "PA_AllPurp_GRAVITY.omx", 'r') as f:
        for mat_name in purp_mats:
            if mat_name not in f.list_matrices():
                print(f"⚠️ {mat_name} not found in OMX")
                continue
            mat = f[mat_name][:].astype(float)
            total_trips = mat.sum()
            intra_trips = np.trace(mat)
            results.append({
                "PURP": mat_name,
                "total_trips": total_trips,
                "intra_trips": intra_trips,
                "pct_intrazonal": 100 * intra_trips / total_trips
            })
    return pd.DataFrame(results)[['PURP','pct_intrazonal']]

mod_intra = vs.load_per_run(repo_root, _load_mod_intra)
```

```{python}
    'HBOth': '2-HBOth',

    ordered=True
)

# Add numeric order column
df_intra['order'] = df_intra['PURP'].cat.codes

# Sort by order
df_intra = df_intra.sort_values('order')
```

```{python}
# ------------------------------------------------ #
# Preprocess Observed HTS Trips
# ------------------------------------------------ #
obs_trips = hts_trips.copy()

# merge to get large districts and summarize accordingly
obs_trips = obs_trips.merge(tazv10[['CO_TAZID','DISTLRG','CO_FIPS']], how = 'left', left_on='pCO_TAZID_USTMv4', right_on='CO_TAZID')
obs_trips = obs_trips.rename(columns={'DISTLRG':'p_DistLrg', 'CO_FIPS':'p_CO_FIPS'}).drop(columns={'CO_TAZID'})
obs_trips = obs_trips.merge(tazv10[['CO_TAZID','DISTLRG','CO_FIPS']], how = 'left', left_on='aCO_TAZID_USTMv4', right_on='CO_TAZID')
obs_trips = obs_trips.rename(columns={'DISTLRG':'a_DistLrg', 'CO_FIPS':'a_CO_FIPS'}).drop(columns={'CO_TAZID'})

# ------------------------------------------------ #
# Preprocess Modeled Skim Data (one calibration run at a time)
# ------------------------------------------------ #
taz_ids = np.arange(1, 3630)

def _load_master_trips(calib_run, outputs_dir):
    od_results = []
    with omx.open_file(outputs_dir / "PA_AllPurp_GRAVITY.omx", 'r') as f:
        for mat_name in purp_mats:
            if mat_name not in f.list_matrices():
                print(f"⚠️ {mat_name} not found in OMX")
                continue
            mat = f[mat_name][:].astype(float)
            ii, jj = np.nonzero(mat)
            od_results.extend(
                {"i": taz_ids[i], "j": taz_ids[j], "trips": mat[i, j], "purpose": mat_name}
                for i, j in zip(ii, jj)
            )

    mod_trips = pd.DataFrame(od_results)
    mod_trips = mod_trips.merge(tazv10[['TAZID','DISTLRG','CO_FIPS']], how = 'left', left_on='i', right_on='TAZID')
    mod_trips = mod_trips.rename(columns={'DISTLRG':'p_DistLrg', 'CO_FIPS':'p_CO_FIPS'}).drop(columns={'TAZID'})
    mod_trips = mod_trips.merge(tazv10[['TAZID','DISTLRG','CO_FIPS']], how = 'left', left_on='j', right_on='TAZID')
    mod_trips = mod_trips.rename(columns={'DISTLRG':'a_DistLrg', 'CO_FIPS':'a_CO_FIPS'}).drop(columns={'TAZID'})
    mod_trips = mod_trips.rename(columns={'purpose':'PURP'})

    mod_trips_dist = mod_trips.groupby(['PURP','p_DistLrg','a_DistLrg'], as_index=False).agg(trips=('trips','sum'))
    mod_trips_co = mod_trips.groupby(['PURP','p_CO_FIPS','a_CO_FIPS'], as_index=False).agg(trips=('trips','sum'))
    mod_trips_dist['Geo'] = 'District'
    mod_trips_co['Geo'] = 'County'
    mod_trips_dist = mod_trips_dist.rename(columns={'p_DistLrg': 'p_Loc', 'a_DistLrg': 'a_Loc', 'trips': 'mod'})
    mod_trips_co = mod_trips_co.rename(columns={'p_CO_FIPS': 'p_Loc', 'a_CO_FIPS': 'a_Loc', 'trips': 'mod'})
    return pd.concat([mod_trips_dist, mod_trips_co], ignore_index=True)

mod_trips_all = vs.load_per_run(repo_root, _load_master_trips)

# ------------------------------------------------ #
# Summarize Observed (shared, not run-specific)
# ------------------------------------------------ #
obs_trips_dist = obs_trips.groupby(['PURP','p_DistLrg','a_DistLrg'], as_index=False).agg(trips=('trip_weight','sum'))
obs_trips_co = obs_trips.groupby(['PURP','p_CO_FIPS','a_CO_FIPS'], as_index=False).agg(trips=('trip_weight','sum'))
obs_trips_dist['Geo'] = 'District'
obs_trips_co['Geo'] = 'County'
obs_trips_dist = obs_trips_dist.rename(columns={'p_DistLrg': 'p_Loc', 'a_DistLrg': 'a_Loc', 'trips': 'obs'})
obs_trips_co = obs_trips_co.rename(columns={'p_CO_FIPS': 'p_Loc', 'a_CO_FIPS': 'a_Loc', 'trips': 'obs'})
obs_trips_all = pd.concat([obs_trips_dist, obs_trips_co], ignore_index=True)

# Merge Model (per run) and Observed (shared) -- calib_run isn't a merge
# key, so it rides along on the modeled side, same pattern as elsewhere
master_trips = mod_trips_all.merge(
    obs_trips_all, on=['PURP', 'p_Loc', 'a_Loc', 'Geo'], how='outer'
).fillna({'mod': 0, 'obs': 0})

# filter out HBC
master_trips = master_trips[~(master_trips['PURP']=='HBC')]

# ------------------------------------------------ #
# ADD "AllPurps" CATEGORY (per calib_run)
# ------------------------------------------------ #
all_purps = master_trips.groupby(['p_Loc', 'a_Loc', 'Geo', 'calib_run'], as_index=False).agg({'mod': 'sum','obs': 'sum'})
all_purps['PURP'] = 'AllPurps'
master_trips2 = pd.concat([master_trips, all_purps], ignore_index=True)
```

```{python}
def _load_dist_sum_mod(calib_run, outputs_dir):
    #--------------------------------------------------------------------#
    # Modeled: Destination Choice Model                                  #
    #--------------------------------------------------------------------#
    dist_sum_mod_mc = pd.read_csv(outputs_dir / "DISTLRG_PA_AllPurp.csv", low_memory=False)[['I','J','HBW','HBO','NHB','HBSch','HBC']]
    dist_sum_mod_mc = dist_sum_mod_mc.rename(columns={'I':'p_DistLrg', 'J':'a_DistLrg'})
    dist_sum_mod_mc = dist_sum_mod_mc.melt(
        id_vars=['p_DistLrg', 'a_DistLrg'],
        value_vars=['HBW', 'HBO', 'NHB', 'HBSch', 'HBC'],
        var_name='PURP5_t',
        value_name='total_trips'
    )
    dist_sum_mod_mc['Source'] = 'Destination Choice'

    #--------------------------------------------------------------------#
    # Modeled: Gravity Choice Model                                      #
    #--------------------------------------------------------------------#
    dist_sum_mod_db = pd.read_csv(outputs_dir / "DISTLRG_PA_Gravity_AllPurp.csv", low_memory=False)
    dist_sum_mod_db['HBO'] = dist_sum_mod_db['HBOth'] + dist_sum_mod_db['HBShp']
    dist_sum_mod_db['HBSch'] = dist_sum_mod_db['HBSch_Pr'] + dist_sum_mod_db['HBSch_Sc']
    dist_sum_mod_db['NHB'] = dist_sum_mod_db['NHBW'] + dist_sum_mod_db['NHBNW']
    dist_sum_mod_db = dist_sum_mod_db[['I','J','HBW','HBO','NHB','HBSch','HBC']]
    dist_sum_mod_db = dist_sum_mod_db.rename(columns={'I':'p_DistLrg', 'J':'a_DistLrg'})
    dist_sum_mod_db = dist_sum_mod_db.melt(
        id_vars=['p_DistLrg', 'a_DistLrg'],
        value_vars=['HBW', 'HBO', 'NHB', 'HBSch', 'HBC'],
        var_name='PURP5_t',
        value_name='total_trips'
    )
    dist_sum_mod_db['Source'] = 'Gravity'

    dist_sum_mod = pd.concat([dist_sum_mod_mc, dist_sum_mod_db], ignore_index=True)
    dist_sum_mod = dist_sum_mod[dist_sum_mod['PURP5_t']=='HBW']
    return dist_sum_mod[['Source','p_DistLrg','a_DistLrg','total_trips']]

dist_sum_mod_chart = vs.load_per_run(repo_root, _load_dist_sum_mod)

#--------------------------------------------------------------------#
# Observed: Household Travel Survey                                  #
#--------------------------------------------------------------------#
hts_trips_in_dc = pd.read_csv(config_paths["hts_trips_path"], low_memory=False)
hts_trips_dc = hts_trips_in_dc.copy()[['linked_trip_id','PURP5_t','pCO_TAZID_USTMv4','aCO_TAZID_USTMv4','trip_weight']]

# merge to get large districts and summarize accordingly
dist_sum_obs_1 = hts_trips_dc.merge(tazv10_st, how = 'left', left_on='pCO_TAZID_USTMv4', right_on='CO_TAZID')
dist_sum_obs_1 = dist_sum_obs_1.rename(columns={'DISTLRG':'p_DistLrg'}).drop(columns={'CO_TAZID'})
dist_sum_obs_2 = dist_sum_obs_1.merge(tazv10_st, how = 'left', left_on='aCO_TAZID_USTMv4', right_on='CO_TAZID')
dist_sum_obs_2 = dist_sum_obs_2.rename(columns={'DISTLRG':'a_DistLrg'}).drop(columns={'CO_TAZID'})

# summarize data
dist_sum_obs = (
    dist_sum_obs_2
        .groupby(
            ['p_DistLrg', 'a_DistLrg', 'PURP5_t'],
            dropna=False
        )['trip_weight']
        .sum()
        .reset_index(name='total_trips')
)

# filter data
dist_sum_obs = dist_sum_obs[
    (dist_sum_obs['total_trips'] != 0) &
    (dist_sum_obs['p_DistLrg'].notna()) &
    (dist_sum_obs['a_DistLrg'].notna())
]

#--------------------------------------------------------------------#
# Prep Observed for Charts (dist_sum_mod_chart already built above,
# per calibration run, via _load_dist_sum_mod)                       #
#--------------------------------------------------------------------#
dist_sum_obs = dist_sum_obs.copy()
dist_sum_obs = dist_sum_obs[dist_sum_obs['PURP5_t']=='HBW']
dist_sum_obs = dist_sum_obs[['p_DistLrg','a_DistLrg','total_trips']]

# combine to get observed for both
obs_dc = dist_sum_obs.copy()
obs_dc["Source"] = "Destination Choice"
obs_grav = dist_sum_obs.copy()
obs_grav["Source"] = "Gravity"
dist_sum_obs_chart = pd.concat([obs_dc, obs_grav], ignore_index=True)
```

```{python}
#=============================================================================#
# Production & Attractions by Vehicle Ownership & Income Category            #
#=============================================================================#
df_trip = pd.read_csv(config_paths["hts_trips_path"], low_memory=False)
df_hh = pd.read_csv(config_paths["hts_hh"], low_memory=False)

#--------------------------------------------------------------------#
# Process Observed Data (HTS)                                        #
#--------------------------------------------------------------------#
# calculate vehicle category - income category variables
hts_hh_23_hbw_merge = df_hh.copy()
hts_hh_23_hbw_merge['inc'] = np.select(
    [hts_hh_23_hbw_merge['income_detailed'].between(1, 4),hts_hh_23_hbw_merge['income_detailed'].between(5, 10)],
    ['lo', 'hi'],
    default=pd.NA
)
hts_hh_23_hbw_merge['veh'] = np.select(
    [hts_hh_23_hbw_merge['num_vehicles'] == 0,hts_hh_23_hbw_merge['num_vehicles'] == 1,hts_hh_23_hbw_merge['num_vehicles'].between(2, 7)],
    ['0', '1', '2'],
    default=pd.NA
)
hts_hh_23_hbw_merge['veh_inc'] = (
    'HBW_' + hts_hh_23_hbw_merge['veh'] + 'veh_' + hts_hh_23_hbw_merge['inc']
)
hts_hh_23_hbw_merge = hts_hh_23_hbw_merge[['hh_id','veh_inc']]

#--------------------------------------------------------------------#
# Summarize Observed Data (HTS)                                      #
#--------------------------------------------------------------------#
# observed data continued
hts_trip_hbw_0 = df_trip.copy()
hts_trip_hbw_0 = hts_trip_hbw_0.merge(hts_hh_23_hbw_merge,how='left',on='hh_id')

# merge to get large districts
hts_trip_hbw_1 = hts_trip_hbw_0.merge(tazv10_st, how = 'left', left_on='pCO_TAZID_USTMv4', right_on='CO_TAZID')
hts_trip_hbw_1 = hts_trip_hbw_1.rename(columns={'DISTLRG':'p_DistLrg'}).drop(columns={'CO_TAZID'})
hts_trip_hbw_2 = hts_trip_hbw_1.merge(tazv10_st, how = 'left', left_on='aCO_TAZID_USTMv4', right_on='CO_TAZID')
hts_trip_hbw_2 = hts_trip_hbw_2.rename(columns={'DISTLRG':'a_DistLrg'}).drop(columns={'CO_TAZID'})

# filter and cleanup
hts_trip_hbw = hts_trip_hbw_2[['unique_id','PURP7_t','veh_inc','p_DistLrg','a_DistLrg','trip_weight']]
hts_trip_hbw = hts_trip_hbw[(hts_trip_hbw['p_DistLrg'] > 0) & (hts_trip_hbw['a_DistLrg'] > 0)]
hts_trip_hbw = hts_trip_hbw[hts_trip_hbw['PURP7_t']=='HBW']
hts_trip_hbw = hts_trip_hbw[hts_trip_hbw['trip_weight']>0]
hts_trip_hbw = hts_trip_hbw[~(hts_trip_hbw['veh_inc'].isna())]
hts_trip_hbw['p_DistLrg'] = hts_trip_hbw['p_DistLrg'].astype(int)
hts_trip_hbw['a_DistLrg'] = hts_trip_hbw['a_DistLrg'].astype(int)
hts_trip_hbw = hts_trip_hbw[['veh_inc','p_DistLrg','a_DistLrg','trip_weight']]

# summarize
obs_dist_hbw_sum = (
    hts_trip_hbw
        [['veh_inc','p_DistLrg','a_DistLrg','trip_weight']]
        .groupby(['veh_inc','p_DistLrg','a_DistLrg'], as_index=False)
        .agg(total_trips=('trip_weight','sum'))
)

#--------------------------------------------------------------------#
# Process + Summarize Modeled Data (OMX Files, one run at a time)     #
#--------------------------------------------------------------------#
def parse_veh_inc(fname):
    base = os.path.splitext(fname)[0]      # pa_HBW_2veh_hi_noXI
    base = base.replace("pa_", "")         # HBW_2veh_hi_noXI
    base = base.replace("_noXI", "")       # HBW_2veh_hi
    return base

_hbw_veh_files = [
    "pa_HBW_0veh_hi.omx",
    "pa_HBW_0veh_lo.omx",
    "pa_HBW_1veh_hi.omx",
    "pa_HBW_1veh_lo.omx",
    "pa_HBW_2veh_hi_noXI.omx",
    "pa_HBW_2veh_lo_noXI.omx",
]

def _load_mod_dist_hbw_sum(calib_run, outputs_dir):
    dfs = []
    for f in _hbw_veh_files:
        with omx.open_file(outputs_dir / f, "r") as omx_file:
            mat = omx_file["trips"][:]
        df = (
            pd.DataFrame(mat)
              .reset_index()
              .melt(id_vars="index", var_name="a_taz", value_name="trips")
              .rename(columns={"index": "p_taz"})
        )
        df["p_taz"] += 1  # shift from 0-based to 1-based TAZ
        df["a_taz"] += 1
        df["veh_inc"] = parse_veh_inc(f)
        dfs.append(df)
    mod_taz_hbw_0 = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    mod_taz_hbw_1 = mod_taz_hbw_0.merge(tazv10_wf, how = 'left', left_on='p_taz', right_on='TAZID')
    mod_taz_hbw_1 = mod_taz_hbw_1.rename(columns={'DISTLRG':'p_DistLrg'}).drop(columns={'TAZID'})
    mod_taz_hbw_2 = mod_taz_hbw_1.merge(tazv10_wf, how = 'left', left_on='a_taz', right_on='TAZID')
    mod_taz_hbw_2 = mod_taz_hbw_2.rename(columns={'DISTLRG':'a_DistLrg'}).drop(columns={'TAZID'})

    return (
        mod_taz_hbw_2
            [['veh_inc','p_DistLrg','a_DistLrg','trips']]
            .groupby(['veh_inc','p_DistLrg','a_DistLrg'], as_index=False)
            .agg(total_trips=('trips','sum'))
    )

mod_dist_hbw_sum = vs.load_per_run(repo_root, _load_mod_dist_hbw_sum)

#--------------------------------------------------------------------#
# Process Observed Data (HTS): No Outliers                           #
#--------------------------------------------------------------------#
hbw_outliers = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        ("0veh_hi", 16.0, 16.0, 945.865752),
        ("0veh_hi", 24.0, 22.0, 260.006460),
        ("0veh_lo", 12.0, 14.0, 1041.594276),

        ("2veh_lo", 21.0, 20.0, 1746.499851),

hbw_outliers["veh_inc"] = "HBW_" + hbw_outliers["segment"]
hbw_outliers = hbw_outliers[["veh_inc", "p_DistLrg", "a_DistLrg", "trips_weight"]]
```

```{python}
def _load_mod_distrib_hbw_sum(calib_run, outputs_dir):
    # ---------------------------
    # 1) LOAD
    # ---------------------------
    hhdisag_dfs = {
        s: pd.DataFrame(DBF(outputs_dir / f"VO_HH{s}_IncLoHi_Worker_VehOwn.dbf", load=True))
        for s in range(1, 7)
    }

    # ---------------------------
    # 2) COLLAPSE WORKERS (W)
    # ---------------------------
    for s, df in hhdisag_dfs.items():
        for inc in ["L", "H"]:
            for v in range(4):
                cols = [f"S{s}I{inc}W{w}V{v}" for w in range(4)]
                df[f"S{s}I{inc}V{v}"] = df[cols].sum(axis=1)

    # ---------------------------
    # 3) LEFT-JOIN ALL 6 ON Z
    # ---------------------------
    Z_COLS = ["Z"]

    dfs_list = [hhdisag_dfs[s] for s in range(1, 7)]

    df_merged = reduce(
        lambda left, right: pd.merge(left, right, on=Z_COLS, how="left"),
        dfs_list
    )

    # ---------------------------
    # 4) COLLAPSE HOUSEHOLD SIZE (S)
    # ---------------------------
    final_hhdisag_vals = df_merged[Z_COLS].copy()

    for inc in ["L", "H"]:
        for v in range(4):
            cols = [f"S{s}I{inc}V{v}" for s in range(1, 7)]
            final_hhdisag_vals[f"I{inc}V{v}"] = df_merged[cols].sum(axis=1)

    # ---------------------------
    # 5) KEEP ONLY Z + I/V
    # ---------------------------
    final_hhdisag_vals = final_hhdisag_vals[Z_COLS + [c for c in final_hhdisag_vals.columns if c.startswith("I")]]

    # Combine 2 and 3 vehicles into 2+ and overwrite V2
    for inc in ["L", "H"]:
        # Add 3-vehicle to 2-vehicle
        final_hhdisag_vals[f"I{inc}V2"] = final_hhdisag_vals[f"I{inc}V2"] + final_hhdisag_vals[f"I{inc}V3"]

    # Drop the old 3-vehicle columns
    final_hhdisag_vals = final_hhdisag_vals.drop(columns=[f"I{inc}V3" for inc in ["L","H"]])

    # ---------------------------
    # 6) CALCULATE percentages
    # ---------------------------
    final_hhdisag_pct = final_hhdisag_vals.copy()
    row_totals = final_hhdisag_pct.drop(columns=Z_COLS).sum(axis=1)
    final_hhdisag_pct.loc[:, final_hhdisag_pct.columns.difference(Z_COLS)] = (
        final_hhdisag_pct.drop(columns=Z_COLS).div(row_totals, axis=0)
    )
    final_hhdisag_pct.loc[:, final_hhdisag_pct.columns.difference(Z_COLS)] = final_hhdisag_pct.loc[:, final_hhdisag_pct.columns.difference(Z_COLS)].round(4)

    final_hhdisag_pct = final_hhdisag_pct.fillna(0)

    # -----------------------------
    # Read in PA_AllPurp_Gravity Matrix from Distribution
    # -----------------------------
    taz_ids = list(range(1, 3630))  # 1-based

    with omx.open_file(outputs_dir / "PA_AllPurp_GRAVITY.omx", 'r') as f:
        mat = f['HBW'][:].astype(float)

    df = pd.DataFrame(mat, index=taz_ids, columns=taz_ids)
    hbw_distrib_trips = df.stack().reset_index()
    hbw_distrib_trips.columns = ['i', 'j', 'trips']

    # -----------------------------
    # Calculate income/vehicle ownerhsip breakdown
    # -----------------------------
    mod_distrib_hbw = hbw_distrib_trips.merge(final_hhdisag_pct, left_on="i", right_on="Z", how="left").drop(columns=["Z"])
    mod_distrib_hbw['HBW_0veh_lo'] = mod_distrib_hbw['ILV0'] * mod_distrib_hbw['trips']
    mod_distrib_hbw['HBW_0veh_hi'] = mod_distrib_hbw['IHV0'] * mod_distrib_hbw['trips']
    mod_distrib_hbw['HBW_1veh_lo'] = mod_distrib_hbw['ILV1'] * mod_distrib_hbw['trips']
    mod_distrib_hbw['HBW_1veh_hi'] = mod_distrib_hbw['IHV1'] * mod_distrib_hbw['trips']
    mod_distrib_hbw['HBW_2veh_lo'] = mod_distrib_hbw['ILV2'] * mod_distrib_hbw['trips']
    mod_distrib_hbw['HBW_2veh_hi'] = mod_distrib_hbw['IHV2'] * mod_distrib_hbw['trips']

    hbw_cols = ['HBW_0veh_lo', 'HBW_0veh_hi','HBW_1veh_lo', 'HBW_1veh_hi','HBW_2veh_lo', 'HBW_2veh_hi']
    mod_distrib_hbw_long = mod_distrib_hbw.melt(
        id_vars=['i', 'j'],
        value_vars=hbw_cols,
        var_name='veh_inc',
        value_name='hbw_trips'
    )
    mod_distrib_hbw_long = mod_distrib_hbw_long.rename(columns={'hbw_trips':'trips'})

    # -----------------------------
    # Summrize at Large District level
    # -----------------------------
    mod_distrib_hbw_1 = mod_distrib_hbw_long.merge(tazv10_wf, how = 'left', left_on='i', right_on='TAZID')
    mod_distrib_hbw_1 = mod_distrib_hbw_1.rename(columns={'DISTLRG':'p_DistLrg'}).drop(columns={'TAZID'})
    mod_distrib_hbw_2 = mod_distrib_hbw_1.merge(tazv10_wf, how = 'left', left_on='j', right_on='TAZID')
    mod_distrib_hbw_2 = mod_distrib_hbw_2.rename(columns={'DISTLRG':'a_DistLrg'}).drop(columns={'TAZID'})

    return (
        mod_distrib_hbw_2
            [['veh_inc','p_DistLrg','a_DistLrg','trips']]
            .groupby(['veh_inc','p_DistLrg','a_DistLrg'], as_index=False)
            .agg(total_trips=('trips','sum'))
    )

mod_distrib_hbw_sum = vs.load_per_run(repo_root, _load_mod_distrib_hbw_sum)
```

```{ojs}
// 1. DATA PROCESSING & INPUTS
dc = {
  const modT = transpose(dist_sum_mod).filter(d => d.calib_run === globalCalibRun);
  const obsT = transpose(dist_sum_obs);

  return modT.map(m => {
    const o = obsT.find(d =>
      d.p_DistLrg === m.p_DistLrg &&
      d.a_DistLrg === m.a_DistLrg &&
      d.Source === m.Source
    );

    if (!o || o.total_trips === 0) return null;

    return {
      p_DistLrg: m.p_DistLrg,
      a_DistLrg: m.a_DistLrg,
      Source: m.Source,
      tmeMod: m.total_trips,
      tmeObs: o.total_trips,
      // Added Percent Error calculation for the second chart
      tmeErrorPct: (m.total_trips - o.total_trips) / o.total_trips
    };
  }).filter(d => d !== null);
}

// Source Selection
viewof vSource = Inputs.select(
  Array.from(new Set(dc.map(d => d.Source))).sort(),
  { label: "Model Source:" }
)

// Filtered data based on selection
dc_filtered = dc.filter(d => d.Source === vSource)

// Shared Max for the Scatter Plot axes
chartMax = d3.max(dc_filtered, d => Math.max(d.tmeObs, d.tmeMod))
```

```{ojs}
// 1. STABLE SELECTIONS
vincs_list = Array.from(
  new Set(transpose(dist_sum_obs2).map(d => String(d.veh_inc).replace(/^HBW_/, "")))
).sort()

// Model Type Selection
viewof vSource_2 = Inputs.select(
  ["Destination Choice", "Gravity"],
  { label: "Model Type:", value: "Destination Choice" }
)

// Observed Data Selection
viewof vRemoveOutliers_2 = Inputs.toggle({
  label: "Remove outliers",
  value: false
})

// 2. DATA PROCESSING (Matches selected model source to selected observed data)
dc_2 = {
  const modT2 = transpose(dist_sum_mod2).filter(d => d.calib_run === globalCalibRun);
  const obsT2 = vRemoveOutliers_2
    ? transpose(dist_sum_obs2_no_outliers)
    : transpose(dist_sum_obs2);

  return modT2.map(m => {
    const o = obsT2.find(d =>
      d.p_DistLrg === m.p_DistLrg &&
      d.a_DistLrg === m.a_DistLrg &&
      d.veh_inc === m.veh_inc
    );

    if (!o || o.total_trips === 0) return null;

    return {
      p_DistLrg: m.p_DistLrg,
      a_DistLrg: m.a_DistLrg,
      veh_inc: m.veh_inc,
      veh_inc_clean: String(m.veh_inc).replace(/^HBW_/, ""),
      Source: m.Source,
      tmeMod: m.total_trips,
      tmeObs: o.total_trips,
      tmeErrorPct: (m.total_trips - o.total_trips) / o.total_trips
    };
  }).filter(d => d !== null);
}

// 3. FINAL FILTERING
dc_filtered_2 = dc_2.filter(d => d.Source === vSource_2)

// 4. NOTEBOOK-MATCHED METRICS
slope_through_origin = (rows) => {
  const denominator = d3.sum(rows, d => d.tmeObs * d.tmeObs);
  return denominator > 0
    ? d3.sum(rows, d => d.tmeObs * d.tmeMod) / denominator
    : 0;
}

wmape = (rows) => {
  const totalObs = d3.sum(rows, d => d.tmeObs);
  return totalObs > 0
    ? d3.sum(rows, d => Math.abs(d.tmeMod - d.tmeObs)) / totalObs
    : 0;
}

segment_summaries = vincs_list.map(seg => {
  const rows = dc_filtered_2.filter(d => d.veh_inc_clean === seg);
  return {
    seg,
    rows,
    slope: slope_through_origin(rows),
    wmape: wmape(rows),
    maxVal: d3.max(rows, d => Math.max(d.tmeObs, d.tmeMod)) || 1
  };
})

global_wmape_2 = wmape(dc_filtered_2)
avg_slope_2 = d3.mean(segment_summaries.filter(d => d.rows.length > 1), d => d.slope) || 0
obs_label_2 = vRemoveOutliers_2 ? "No Outliers" : "Standard"
```

```{ojs}
      marginBottom: 42,
      x: { label: "Obs Trips", domain: [0, axisMax] },
      y: { label: "Mod Trips", domain: [0, axisMax] },
      marks: [
        Plot.link(fanRatios, {
          x1: 0,
          y1: 0,
          x2: maxVal,
          y2: (r) => maxVal * r,
          stroke: "gray",
          strokeOpacity: (r) => r === 1 ? 1 : 0.25,
          strokeWidth: (r) => r === 1 ? 2 : 1,
          strokeDasharray: (r) => r === 1 ? null : "2 2"
        }),
        Plot.dot(rows, {
          x: "tmeObs",
          y: "tmeMod",
          r: 3,
          fill: "rgb(80, 116, 230)",
          fillOpacity: 0.6,
          tip: true,
          title: (d) =>
            `District: ${d.p_DistLrg} to ${d.a_DistLrg}\n` +
            `Observed: ${d3.format(",.0f")(d.tmeObs)}\n` +
            `Modeled: ${d3.format(",.0f")(d.tmeMod)}`
        }),
        Plot.line(
          [
            { x: 0, y: 0 },
            { x: maxVal, y: summary.slope * maxVal }
          ],
          {
            x: "x",
            y: "y",
            stroke: "rgb(80, 116, 230)",
            strokeWidth: 2,
            strokeDasharray: "4 4"
          }
        )
      ]
    })}
  </div>`;
}

html`<div>
  <style>
    .hbw-segment-summary {
      font-weight: 600;
      margin: 0.75rem 0 1rem 0;
    }
    .hbw-segment-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(360px, 1fr));
      gap: 0.75rem;
      align-items: start;
    }
    .hbw-segment-chart h4 {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      margin: 0 0 0.25rem 0;
      line-height: 1.25;
    }
    @media (max-width: 960px) {
      .hbw-segment-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }
  </style>
  <div class="hbw-segment-summary">
    Run: ${vSource_2} | Obs: ${obs_label_2} | Global WMAPE: ${d3.format(".1%")(global_wmape_2)} | Avg Slope: ${d3.format(".2f")(avg_slope_2)}
  </div>
  <div class="hbw-segment-grid">
    ${segment_summaries.map(segment_chart)}

</div>`
```
